summary: Held the entire episode. This entry showed extreme whipsaw for all 23 frames -- price oscillated repeatedly between roughly -45 and +48 pts with no sustained one-directional breakdown; every deep dip (frame 3's -45.5, frame 14's dip) fully recovered within 1-4 frames, and against-signal fires (KMDR/CLIMAX/HA/PROPP) kept flipping sign rather than stacking persistently in one direction. Never saw the signature of a genuine wrong-direction entry (a new low breaking the prior swing low with against-fires compounding and no bounce), so judged the thesis intact throughout and held to the window's end. Next time I'd watch for a decisive break below the established range low (not just matching it) combined with 3+ against-fires all fresh in the same frame as the disqualifying signal to bail on.
